name: Yibin City Commercial Bank Co., Ltd
summary: Yibin City Commercial Bank Co., Ltd provides banking and financial products and services to small and micro enterprises in the People's Republic of China. Its deposit products include demand, regular, personal notice, fixed term and flexible savings, and education savings. The company also offers white collar credit, housing loan, personal home, and renovation loan and business loans; specialized services, online, mobile, and telephone banking. Further, the company engages in wealth management; asset management, including financial product design and management; interbank lending, deposits, certificate of deposit, and investment; bond repurchase; spot bond trading; and bill rediscounting.
